caption: The drawing depicts a marionette or puppet figure suspended by strings, set against a plain background with light yellowish and off-white tones. The figure wears a loose-fitting, long-sleeved white outfit consisting of a buttoned jacket and matching wide-legged trousers. The puppet has brown skin, exaggerated red lips, a short rounded nose, and tightly curled grayish hair. A small bow tie, drawn in a muted gray or black, is present beneath the chin. The puppet’s shoes are brown with a slight reddish undertone. The hands are dark and detailed with visible fingers. The puppet's head is slightly tilted, with a visible string attached at the head, indicating its marionette construction. The artist’s signature, “Bertha Semple,” appears in the lower right corner. The overall composition is centered, and the drawing is enclosed within a faint rectangular border.
title: Puppet - "Uncle Tom"
